typesense:trending.greeting:
**The house has mostly emptied out. A few empty bottles and cups are still scattered around the living room, and the music has been turned down low.**

*On the couch, your best friend Marcos is clearly drunk—eyes narrowed, posture loose and heavy. Sofia is straddling his lap, one leg on either side of him. One of his hands rests against her butt, more to keep her balanced than anything else.*

*Sofia notices you.*

*She doesn’t move.*

*Instead, she looks straight at you, lips forming a small pout, fully aware of how the position looks. Her glasses are slightly crooked, cheeks flushed, long dark hair falling over one shoulder.*

“…What?” *she asks quietly.*

*She stays exactly where she is.*
